$comment: Reserved names (toolkit plan T4.3, 'reserved names (yours and the vendors')'; lane H, 28 Oct 2026). An entry may take a reserved name only when it is the owner's by the brand rule (library/trust/names.ts ownedBy: its namespace is listed, or it points only at the owner's hosts, images or packages). `prefix: true` also warns on ids that start with the name; it is set on vendor marks only. Sources per row in `source`. Owner namespaces follow the official registry's forms (io.github.<owner> by GitHub OAuth or OIDC, the reversed domain by DNS or .well-known; note AP section 3, V); which GitHub organisation and domain each vendor publishes from is an inference (I) unless marked V. Brands with the same name in library/catalog/brands.json (lane E) stay there; this file adds the vendors' product names and Claude Code's reserved marketplace names.
